decisions.reason: The charting bundle builds on the established map.apps platform and shows active development with four releases in four weeks, which signals results meeting aspirations at low marginal cost.

This small search bundle sits close to the core platform and costs little to maintain, so in a growing industry with slack it gives no reason for problemistic search, though it is only mentioned on the website.
The mobile layer control was featured on the home page with a usability improvement, so it looks satisfactory, though as a niche component it could later be absorbed into other offerings.
The GIS solution platform is close to the core business and underpins customer projects, so a firm with growing turnover and R&D slack keeps it.
Mobile field data capture has its own page and meets clear public-sector and utility demand, so its performance likely meets aspirations.
The search extension has its own page and fits the web map app portfolio, so given low maintenance cost and available slack there is no reason to drop it.
